notes:
Summary: Zepto Response Systems runs an ad-exchange decisioning layer that needs sub-25ms p99 end-to-end inference for bid scoring and reranking. Extremely cost sensitive — margins are tight; they want predictable unit economics. Interested in Redwood Dedicated for predictable throughput + VPC peering, but open to hybrid with hosted API fallbacks during traffic spikes.

Key asks / quotes: 
- 'We need repeatable p99 numbers under production traffic (1k qps burst) to commit to a vendor.' — CTO (A. Venkataraman).
- 'If quantization saves 3x cost but degrades top-k recall by >1.5% it's a non-starter.' — Head of ML.

Technical priorities (from call):
- Latency: target <=25ms p99, typical tail matters more than avg.
- Throughput: spikes to 1k qps sustained for 5–10 minutes, steady-state 200–350 qps.
- Cost: looking to reduce per-req inference cost by at least 2x vs current managed endpoints.
- Model preferences: open transformer-based reranker (custom fine-tuned Llama-variant), willing to test 4-bit/8-bit quantized variants if accuracy delta <1.5% absolute on business metrics.
- Routing/fallback: primary dedicated pool in us-east, fallback to hosted-api in other regions; regional residency for EU-sensitive accounts.
- Caching: interested in prefix/KV cache for repeated session contexts and a front-line LRU cache for top-k candidates.
- Batching policy: must support micro-batching with latency SLO enforcement; want Redwood Optimize recommendations tuned to their traffic profile.

Security & compliance notes:
- Requires SSO/SAML + SCIM for provisioning.
- SOC2 required by procurement; SOC2 report requested (we provided link).
- KMS integration mandatory for keying and audit_logging for all inference requests.

Procurement & timeline:
- Internal procurement kickoff after perf benchmark.
- Aim to have pilot (3-week dedicated pool POC) by 2026-05 and contract decision same month.

CRM shorthand / friction items:
- SE asked to run perf bench with 512-token synthetic trace + production replay (Jira INF-2109).
- Security wants answers on model artifacts residency; flagged SEC-4432.
- Finance wants usage predictability (requesting dedicated reserved commit model + cost model from Redwood).

Attachments and links added to record (drive + fireflies).
